_doc: Same-trial documents a row's packet must carry although they are filed under another PMID. Each entry names why it is the same trial. A companion is evidence about the trial (protocol, design paper); it never supplies the served number unless it reports it.

P53-34.why: PLACIDE study protocol (BMC Infect Dis 2012, PMID 22559011, PMC OA), same ISRCTN70017204 as the results paper PMID 23932219

P53-45.why: CANVAS-R: the CANVAS Program report (PMID 28605608) integrates CANVAS NCT01032629 and CANVAS-R NCT01989754; both registrations are named in the abstract
CANVAS Program heart-failure report (Circulation 2018, PMID 29526832, PMC OA): the source the served row cites; same two registrations

P53-50.why: JUPITER parent registration; PMID 20404379 is a secondary analysis of JUPITER by age
